game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Bat Hollow Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow, a hollow of roosting bats: the cave miner must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow: a hollow of roosting bats
core_gameplay_loop: In Bat Hollow, repeat each round: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed. Each round, glow-eyed lurkers strike the exit ledge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the belt_count value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the exit ledge from glow-eyed lurkers in Bat Hollow: keep the belt_count meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: belt_count drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Loop Counter Conveyor
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how belt_count changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Bat Hollow.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 55 seconds while belt_count > 0.
